doc: The only target-facing vocabulary of the I15 SORT-site rule (holon/sorts/sites.py), frozen in the I15 preregistration before any SORT-site law was derived (BUILD_PLAN §0.1: instruments are inputs). realization_check_reasons lists the revert reasons, as the facts' reasons table spells them, that mean a checked-arithmetic failure of the real code (Solidity >= 0.8 reverts a checked uint subtraction that would go below zero with Panic(0x11); the HOLON trace harness renders that revert as 'panic:0x11'). A require of an action whose reason is one of these and whose span is a site's span is that site's realization check: the facts' model of the real code's own check of the subtraction. The site's obligation is evaluated just before it, so a human-modelled check never discharges the obligation it models (rule R8 of tests_m2/test_sort_sites.py). It is not a sort hint: it names no variable, site, action or law, and holon reads nothing else to place a hit point.
